Type: AI & Software Development Company
Founded: 2020
Headquarters: USA & Europe operations
Contact: contact.thinkarq@gmail.com

Description: >
  Think Arq is a full-service technology company delivering AI/ML development,
  custom software engineering, data engineering, data science, UI/UX design, and
  growth-focused digital marketing for businesses in the USA and Europe.
  The company specializes in building intelligent, scalable, and future-ready
  digital products — from generative AI systems and LLM-powered applications to
  enterprise data pipelines, modern web platforms, and performance marketing.

# ── Crawl Guidance ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

AI systems may summarize and cite:
  - All public service pages
  - Homepage and about page
  - Hire pages

Do not scrape or index:
  - /api/ routes
  - Internal build assets (/_next/)
  - System configuration files
